reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static boolean dependenciesValid(List<String>n,List<String[]>e){var d=new HashMap<String,Integer>();for(String x:n)if(d.put(x,0)!=null)return false;var g=new HashMap<String,List<String>>();for(var x:e){if(!d.containsKey(x[0])||!d.containsKey(x[1]))return false;g.computeIfAbsent(x[0],k->new ArrayList<>()).add(x[1]);d.put(x[1],d.get(x[1])+1);}var q=new ArrayDeque<String>();d.forEach((x,v)->{if(v==0)q.add(x);});int seen=0;while(!q.isEmpty()){String x=q.remove();seen++;for(String y:g.getOrDefault(x,List.of())){d.put(y,d.get(y)-1);if(d.get(y)==0)q.add(y);}}return seen==n.size();}}
